newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rojo warns of autumn mkt upset over EMU.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rojo warns of autumn mkt upset over EMU.

text.p: Spain's central bank governor Luis Angel Rojo warned on Wednesday that financial markets may be unsettled in the autumn over prospects for the start of European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
"In the autumn there may be substantial alterations (in the markets) but things should then become clearer," he told a parlimentary committee.
But he added that the markets are tending to become less agitated by the progress towards the single currency, and were reacting more calmly than expected.
Earlier, Rojo said Spain's monetary policy would remain as prudent as it has been so far, with a view to any potential market volatility on EMU entry.

"Economic policies need to have a certain scope of manoeuvre to face possible future fluctuations in financial markets. This is the reason why the Bank of Spain is using prudently the scope for possible reductions in its money market rate," he said.
